samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of "size" bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of "size" bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 2*size bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size" value="4">Size parameter for the multiplier.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="mul_a_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplicand with 'size' number of zeros added at the MSB.</assign>
        <assign id="mul_b_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplier with 'size' number of zeros added at the MSB.</assign>
        
        <generate>
            <for id="i" start="0" end="size-1">
                <if id="condition">
                    <equal id="eq" lhs="mul_b[i]" rhs="1'b1"/>
                </if>
                <then>
                    <assign id="partial_product[i]" width_description="[7:0]">Partial product generated by multiplying the multiplicand with the corresponding bit of the multiplier.</assign>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <assign id="partial_product[i]" width_description="[7:0]">Zero if the corresponding bit of the multiplier is 0.</assign>
                </else>
            </for>
        </generate>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="sum_reg[0]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the first partial product.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg[1]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the second partial product.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg[2]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the third partial product.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg[3]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the fourth partial product.</reg>
        <always id="addition_block" posedge="clk" negedge="rst_n">
            <if id="reset_condition">
                <not id="neg_rst_n" lhs="rst_n"/>
                <if id="nested_if">
                    <true/>
                </if>
                <then>
                    <block id="reset_action">
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[0]" value="'d0"/>
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[1]" value="'d0"/>
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[2]" value="'d0"/>
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[3]" value="'d0"/>
                    </block>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <block id="update_action">
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[0]" value="partial_product[0] + sum_reg[0]"/>
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[1]" value="partial_product[1] + sum_reg[1]"/>
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[2]" value="partial_product[2] + sum_reg[2]"/>
                        <set id="action" target="sum_reg[3]" value="partial_product[3] + sum_reg[3]"/>
                    </block>
                </else>
            </if>
        </always>
        <reg id="product_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the final product.</reg>
        <always id="final_product_calculation" posedge="clk" negedge="rst_n">
            <if id="reset_condition">
                <not id="neg_rst_n" lhs="rst_n"/>
                <if id="nested_if">
                    <true/>
                </if>
                <then>
                    <set id="action" target="product_reg" value="'d0"/>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <set id="action" target="product_reg" value="sum_reg[0] + sum_reg[1] + sum_reg[2] + sum_reg[3]"/>
                </end
            </if>
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        Extends the input signals by adding 'size' number of zero bits at the MSB positions.
        Performs multiplication operation using a generate block to multiply each bit of the multiplier with the multiplicand.
        Adds the partial products obtained from the multiplication operation using registers.
        Calculates the final product based on the sum of the registers.
    </implementation>
</module>
